elements.element: Services are warranted to be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Terminal Parties warrant that their operation and maintenance duties under Paragraph 10 will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.

elements.element: Deliverables or software are warranted to conform to their documentation.
elements.evidence: Segment T, expressly including incorporated software, is warranted to conform in all material respects to the facilities, functions, and documentation specified in Annex 8.

elements.element: The software conformance warranty lasts 12 months.
elements.evidence: The software conformance warranty lasts only ninety days following the RFS Date.
The warranty for operation and maintenance duties lasts only thirty days following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The responsible Terminal Party must promptly repair or replace the non-conforming Segment T and may re-perform non-conforming duties.
A refund of amounts paid is required if the responsible Terminal Party does not cure within a reasonable period.

elements.element: Vendor warrants compliance with applicable laws.
elements.evidence: No warranty of compliance with applicable laws is included.

elements.element: Vendor warrants that the Services and Deliverables contain no malicious code.
elements.evidence: No warranty regarding malicious code is included.

elements.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Software incorporated in Segment T is warranted to conform in all material respects to Annex 8 documentation for ninety days following the RFS Date.

elements.element: Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
elements.evidence: Operation and maintenance duties are warranted to be professionally and workmanlike performed for thirty days following performance.

elements.element: Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires prompt repair or replacement of non-conforming Segment T and re-performance of non-conforming duties.
The clause requires a refund if cure is not completed within a reasonable period.
